::: {#def-multi-head-attention}

#### Multi-head attention

**Multi-head attention** with $h$ heads runs $h$ copies of [self-attention](#def-self-attention) side by side,
head $i$ with its own matrices $\matr{W}_Q^{(i)}$, $\matr{W}_K^{(i)}$ and $\matr{W}_V^{(i)}$ of size $d \times d / h$.
It joins the $h$ outputs,
each $n \times d / h$,
into one $n \times d$ matrix,
and multiplies that by a $d \times d$ matrix $\matr{W}_O$ of [parameters](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter)
[@vaswani2017attention, section 3.2.2].
Each head can weight the positions in its own way.

:::
